name.description: Name of the person or organization

DerivedFrom.description: Link to a parent file by its FHR-family checksum (specs/004-shared-core-schema FR-003). Provisional until the relationship vocabulary is decided (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#54).

checksum.description: FHR-family checksum of the parent file

headerType.description: FAIR-bioHeaders type of the parent file

relationship.description: How this file relates to the parent. Provisional vocabulary: a PROV-O or Relation Ontology mapping is pending a maintainer decision (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#54).

seqcol_id.description: Sequence collection digest of the parent, if supplied

FHP.description: Metadata for protein FASTA files (proteomes and protein sets).

completeness.description: BUSCO completeness of the protein set, as counts

dateCreated.description: Date the protein set was created

derivedFrom.description: Parent files this file was derived from, identified by their FHR-family checksum. Header types opt in by listing this slot; FHR schemaVersion 1 does not include it.

geneticCode.description: NCBI translation table ID used to translate the sequences (1-6, 9-16 or 21-33); omitted when unknown or when the file mixes tables

isoformPolicy.description: Which protein isoforms of each gene the set contains

predictionProtocol.description: Prediction or annotation protocol or workflow reference URI

predictionSoftware.description: Software that produced the gene models or translations

relatedLink.description: Related URLs to the protein set

reuseConditions.description: Reuse conditions or license for the protein set

schema.description: URL of the FHP JSON Schema this record follows; it identifies the header type (FR-011)

scholarlyArticle.description: Scholarly article where the protein set was published

sequenceStats.description: Counts describing the protein set, as asserted by the producer

source.description: Sources of the sequences that are not FAIR-bioHeaders files, as asserted by the producer; never verified by checksum

sourceType.description: Where the sequences came from: predicted (a gene-prediction or annotation run), database (a published database release, set or annotation run) or mixed (more than one origin). Not a review status.

taxon.description: Species name and URL of the species information at identifiers.org

totalResidues.description: Total number of residues in the file

commandLineOption.description: Command-line options given to the software, in order

assemblyAccession.description: Genome assembly accession that the source states for this set; an assertion by the source, not a checksum link

description.description: What was taken from the source, or how the sequences were contributed

name.description: Name of the database, resource or contribution

release.description: Release or annotation run of the source, as the source names it

sequenceCount.description: Number of sequences in the file that came from this source

setIdentifier.description: Identifier of the set taken from the source, for example a UniProt proteome ID

url.description: URL of the source or set
